title: Partner in a partite matching
statement: Let $q$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of size $k$. The partner of a vertex is the vertex paired with it by the matching.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with q parts of size k
